limits: No connected players; one accepted run per configuration, small differences are preliminary.
Only common spawn/assume/remove helpers use the new protocol. Issued aliases, signals and custom types retain compatible paths.
Opaque DM effects still require fresh numeric state. Parallelism includes independent MC activity and empty-exposure prefix; this is not unrestricted parallel execution of all effects.
Transactional world reactions and legacy native-port access are not all switched to the new transaction overlay.
Short-lived worker thread CPU can be below Windows GetThreadTimes resolution; zero measured CPU with positive jobs/cycles does not mean no work.
approved_changes: Completed gas operations survive later effect failure; remaining effects skipped and exception propagated.
Opt-in pipeline permits feedback delayed by one numerical calculation.
Atomic effect packet in asynchronous worker completion; ordinary atom exposure remains in MC.

scheduler_incompatibility.trigger: The atomic effect packet resumes inside SSair MC budget; overrun increases next_fire.
choices: Atomic world effects in asynchronous worker completion, retain ordinary MC atom processing.
Permit budget portions of the gas-mutating effect packet, with interleaving.
scheduler_incompatibility.user_choice: Atomic effects in asynchronous worker completion; one-calculation feedback delay retained.
